claim: SURMOUNT-1: in obesity without diabetes, 72 weeks of once-weekly tirzepatide 5/10/15 mg reduced body weight by 15.0%/19.5%/20.9% vs 3.1% with placebo.
SURPASS-2: versus semaglutide 1 mg, tirzepatide reduced HbA1c by 2.01–2.30% vs 1.86% and produced greater weight loss; all doses noninferior and superior.
